### Which doc?

- [ ] `README.md`
- [ ] `SKILL.md` (the Anthropic Skill shipped for AI agents)
- [ ] `AGENTS.md` (in-repo guidance for contributors / Cursor / Windsurf)
- [ ] JSDoc / inline type docs in `src/`
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` / release notes
- [ ] Other:

### Audience
Who is the doc failing?

- [ ] Library consumer (someone using `useApi` in their app)
- [ ] AI agent reading the SKILL.md
- [ ] Contributor working on the library

### What's wrong / missing

- [ ] Missing — topic isn't covered at all
- [ ] Unclear — covered but hard to follow
- [ ] Outdated — doesn't match current behavior
- [ ] Incorrect — example doesn't work / wrong type signature

Briefly describe:

### Suggested change
What should the doc say? A rough draft or bullet list is fine.

### Additional Context
Related issues, version this concerns, etc.
